candidate_policy.name: R3-HT
rules: If a public discard outlet discards as an activation cost, ordinary removal of Hashaton cannot erase the resulting Hashaton trigger; do not classify source removal alone as a stop of the current discard attempt.
If the discard happens only when an already-stacked activated/triggered ability resolves, removal of Hashaton before that object resolves is a genuine pre-discard prevention window.
Once a Hashaton trigger exists, removing Hashaton does not erase that trigger.

Lion's Eye Diamond may discard multiple creature cards and create multiple Hashaton triggers. One Tishana's Tidebinder can counter one current trigger, and blank Hashaton only while Tidebinder remains, but it does not erase sibling triggers already on the stack.
If Foil's alternate cost discards a creature while Hashaton is live, that discard creates a Hashaton trigger during the counterwar.
If Tidebinder leaves before its ETB resolves, the target trigger is still countered but Hashaton is not blanked. If Tidebinder leaves later, the blank ends.

invariants: source removal never erases an already-created Hashaton trigger
no response is inserted inside LED mana ability resolution
a single Tidebinder does not erase sibling Hashaton triggers
Tidebinder lifecycle is tracked separately from current-trigger countering
no token or trigger resolution is labeled a game win
no hidden opponent hand information is used by the candidate policy

promotion_scope.if_pass: promote R3-HT as Race public-state timing overlay only
promotion_scope.if_fail: reject R3-HT and return to development with fresh protocol
